provenance.clips: Generated with espeak-ng 1.51 (en-us, speed 140), resampled to 16 kHz mono s16 with ffmpeg. The text of every clip is the reference transcript of that clip.
provenance.clips_license: The speech is synthesized with espeak-ng, which is free software under the GNU General Public License. The generated audio is test data.
provenance.window: The transcription pipeline cuts the audio into windows of 30 seconds, so the cases place speech around the 30 second mark, where the first window ends.
